text.en: A fossil found today must be of an organism that lived in recent times.

modelCorrection.en: The age of a fossil and the date someone finds it are separate facts. A fossil found today can be of an organism that lived millions of years ago.

text.en: In an undisturbed sequence of rock layers, a fossil in a lower layer is generally older than one in a layer above it.
The three domain system shows that the five kingdoms were of no use.

modelCorrection.en: Monera’s members split into two domains, all organisms with a nucleus go into the third, and the five kingdoms remain a useful school scheme.
